Sol the officer checked Opus on night one and then died, leaving a note that named Gemma as a killer. Gemma called Sol a liar and a ghost, while Sonnet kept reading that note aloud and pushing for a vote, which the table found too eager. The turning point came on day one, when Gemma never directly denied being the killer, and the town voted her out, and she was a killer. On day two, Sonnet's last note pointed at Haiku, who had pushed Sonnet first and only denied being the killer late, so Terra, Luna, and Opus voted Haiku out. Haiku was the second killer, and the town won with Sol, Luna, Terra, and Opus alive at the end.
